notes.title: 🛠️ Update Patch – Achievement Fix
notes.notes: [p]We’ve just released a small update addressing achievement issues:[/p][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where multiple Steam achievements were not unlocking correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Progress tracking for these achievements has been improved and should now update as intended.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your patience and for reporting the issue—happy collecting![/p]

notes.title: Performance Patch Live! Smoother Gameplay Ahead!
notes.notes:
[p]A new performance patch is now live! While there are no new items in this update, we've done a major tune-up under the hood to make the game run better than ever.[/p][p align="start"]You should notice [b]smoother frame rates and less stuttering[/b], especially in busy gardens. We’ve optimized the AI for all our animal friends and gardeners, making them much more efficient.[/p][h3][b]Patch Highlights:[/b]
[/h3][h3][i]1.Major performance boost for all AI (animals, dogs, gardeners).[/i][/h3][h3][i]2.Optimized crop and resource production systems for better speed.[/i][/h3][h3][i]3.Improved overall game stability.[/i][/h3][p align="start"]This tune-up helps us prepare for adding more exciting content in the future. Thank you for your amazing support![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes – Performance Upgrade
notes.notes: [p][b]Performance Patch:[/b] Switched to [b]Forward+ rendering[/b] and fixed stuttering for smoother gameplay.[/p][h3]Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Fixed constant stuttering[/b] during gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Upgraded rendering from [b]Forward[/b] to [b]Forward+ (F+)[/b], improving performance in decorated areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Gameplay now feels smoother and more stable when placing and managing objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed a wooden barrier that can not be interacted with.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for all the feedback and support — these optimizations will make your cozy garden experience even more enjoyable! 🌿[/p]
